facts.business: Esaar (India) Limited is a Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending and share trading activities.

auditor.name: B.L. Dasharda & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Due to substantial increase in the volume of transactions in Shares the management has decided from the current year to show the Income from Share Trading as Net gain/(Loss) on Trading of shares in the Statement of Profit & Loss and the closing stock of such shares will be classified under the head Inventories.

key_risks: Impairment of financial assets (expected credit losses) involving significant estimation in grouping of borrowers, staging of loans, determining macro-economic factors, and estimation of losses for loan products with no/minimal historical defaults.
